title: TV and phone must share the same words per phase (TV side)
body: Phone now says START RACE / GET READY / NEXT ROUND / REMATCH / LOBBY / Power. TV owner should use the identical nouns: Lobby (not menu), Power (not PR/PL), and 4-digit TV code (phone says TV code / JOIN, TV should not say PIN or Take your place).
